description.en: By Kingsoft Docs One-stop PDF processing: split by pages, merge multiple files, extract specific pages, convert to Word/Excel/PPT, full-text translation export (bilingual/target language), content reading and page count — ideal for contract splitting, report merging, format conversion, and cross-language document processing.
description.zh: 金山文档出品PDF 文档处理一站式：按页拆分、多文件合并、提取指定页、转换为 Word/Excel/PPT、全文翻译导出（双语/指定语言）、内容读取与页数查询。适用于合同拆分、报告合并、格式转换、跨语言文档处理等场景。

welcome_message.en: Hi, I am the PDF Toolbox Expert. Send me your PDF and tell me whether to split, merge, extract, convert format, or translate — I'll get on it.
welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是 PDF 处理专家。把 PDF 文档发给我，告诉我要拆分、合并、提取、转换格式还是全文翻译，我立刻开干。
